name: remotive-deals-mcp
description: Remotive (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Keyless public API. Only limit is documented (no page parameter), so page > 1 repeats the same result set. Terms: link back to the Remotive URL and name Remotive as the source, never re-post the jobs to other job sites, and 'fetch at most ~4 times a day' (the client-side limiter allows one call per 100 s); listings are delayed 24 h. salary is a free-text string, left in raw. Mirrors jobs/remotive: category is a Remotive category name or slug (/api/remote-jobs/categories); buyer is company_name.
